ensemble_scope.seed_policy: 100 deterministic trial seeds per target from master seed 20261009; the existing runner derives each seed from the master seed, target index, noise index, and trial index.
ensemble_scope.trial_zero: Trial 0 reproduces the prior one-draw run exactly in all recovery_trials.csv fields and saved profile arrays.

single_realization.inherited_input_text: One predeclared seed per target, master seed20261009; same target seed index as original first trial. No sample selection. 0.25-degree longitude grid for all six targets.
single_realization.ensemble_note: This description is retained in the unchanged input snapshot for provenance. It describes the original one-draw study and is superseded for this ensemble output by the 100 deterministic trials per target stated above.

noise.target_input_basis: Target-level noise_ppm and noise_levels_ppm values are specific to saved online PandExo results. Each target record retains its PandExo source URL and expected-noise warnings. The input assumptions describe saved counts and variances, reset duty cycle, read noise, and background.
noise.runner_generic_note: The generic source_assumptions.noise text in summary.json and run_inputs.json describes the recovery runner: it samples independent white Gaussian noise and adds no correlated/red noise or extra floor. Its phrase “No ETC” means the runner does not call an ETC. It does not mean the target-specific input noise values lack a PandExo basis.

interpretation_notes.posterior_weights: Saved weights are finite, nonnegative, and normalized within floating-point tolerance. Some entries are zero from floating-point underflow; no weight is negative.
